The '''Bavakar memory chip''' was an implant developed by [[Bavakar Medical Research Labs]] that released and controlled a cocktail of synthetic nutrients in the body for the purpose of enhancing quick thought in the user.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have the implant feat at level 3.
